author: New England Biolabs

materials: Assemble the following reagents in a thin-walled PCR tube: A B C 1 25 μl RXN FINAL CONC. 2 Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix 12.5 μl 1X 3 10 μM Forward Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM 4 10 μM Reverse Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM 5 Template DNA (1–25 ng/μl) 1 μl 1-25 ng 6 Nuclease-free water 9.0 μl 25 μl RXN FINAL CONC. Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix 12.5 μl 1X 10 μM Forward Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM 10 μM Reverse Primer 1.25 μl 0.5 μM Template DNA (1–25 ng/μl) 1 μl 1-25 ng Nuclease-free water 9.0 μl

Assemble the following reagents: A B C 1   VOLUME FINAL CONC. 2 PCR Product 1 μl   3 2X KLD Reaction Buffer 5 μl 1X 4 10X KLD Enzyme Mix 1 μl 1X 5 Nuclease-free Water 3 μl   VOLUME FINAL CONC. PCR Product 1 μl 2X KLD Reaction Buffer 5 μl 1X 10X KLD Enzyme Mix 1 μl 1X Nuclease-free Water 3 μl
Thaw 50 µL, aliquot of chemically competent E. coli cells On ice . NEB 5-alpha Competent E. coli (High Efficiency), NEB #C2987 , are recommended

Assemble the following reagents: A B C 1 VOLUME FINAL CONC. 2 PCR Product 1 μl 3 2X KLD Reaction Buffer 5 μl 1X 4 10X KLD Enzyme Mix 1 μl 1X 5 Nuclease-free Water 3 μl VOLUME FINAL CONC. PCR Product 1 μl 2X KLD Reaction Buffer 5 μl 1X 10X KLD Enzyme Mix 1 μl 1X Nuclease-free Water 3 μl

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Transfer the reaction to a thermocycler and run the following cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: 25 Cycles of: 98°C for 10 seconds, 50–72°C (optimized annealing temperature) for 10–30 seconds, and 72°C for 20–30 seconds/kb

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Transformation
steps.instruction: Prepare the thawed cells for the KLD treatment.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by pipetting up and down
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes

steps.title: Add KLD Mix
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of KLD mix to the tube of thawed cells.

substeps.instruction: Carefully flick the tube 4-5 times to mix (do not vortex)

steps.title: Perform Heat Shock Transformation
steps.instruction: Execute the transformation sequence using temperature shifts.

substeps.instruction: Place the mixture on ice for 30 minutes

steps.title: Recover Cells
steps.instruction: Recover the transformed cells in SOC medium.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 950 µL of room temperature SOC into the mixture
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour with shaking at 250 rpm
Mix the cells thoroughly by flicking the tube and inverting

steps.title: Plate and Incubate
steps.instruction: Spread the transformation mix onto selection plates and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Spread 50 µL - 100 µL onto a selection plate
Note: For simple substitution and deletion experiments, a 10- to 40-fold dilution of the transformation mix in SOC may be necessary prior to plating to avoid a lawn of colonies
